finalAttemptPolicy.notes: Issuer policy: maximum three credential attempts; remediation required before each retest.

waitingPeriodPolicy.notes: Issuer policy: minimum seven days between credential attempts.

feePolicy.policy: No automatic retest fee at initial program launch. Any future fee must be published before the attempt, applied consistently, and must not penalize an approved accommodation.

periods.failedPracticeAttempts: 90 days after last practice activity, unless linked to an active appeal, security investigation or required audit record
periods.readinessAttempts: 12 months after last readiness activity, unless superseded by a credential attempt or active review
periods.credentialAttempts: 7 years after final attempt disposition, or longer when required by applicable law, contract, accreditation or an unresolved appeal/security matter
periods.evaluatorCalibrationEvidence: 5 years after the calibration evidence is superseded or evaluator authorization ends, whichever is later
periods.appealAdjudicationRecords: 7 years after final appeal disposition, or longer while a related legal/security matter remains open
periods.issuedCredentialVerificationRecords: for the active credential lifetime plus 7 years after expiration, revocation or retirement of the credential record
periods.revokedExpiredCredentials: 7 years after revocation or expiration, with the minimum public verification projection retained only as necessary to verify historical status
periods.securityLogs: 24 months by default; incident-linked logs retained with the incident record until its longer retention requirement expires

summary: Program, assessment, accessibility, security and organizational governance are approved as issuer policy for candidate administration. Privacy/legal approval of the proposed retention/privacy implementation remains pending; operational use is not authorized until that approval is complete.
limitations: ISO/IEC 17024, ADA and FTC sources support the governance principles but do not prescribe the issuer-specific numeric retest or retention values.
Privacy/legal applicability remains open and may require longer or different retention periods by jurisdiction, contract or accreditation.
This approval does not authorize credential issuance or operational candidate governance.
